dialogues.jp: 「……なんか」

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「なんか……なぁ……」
dialogues.en: "You know?"
dialogues.text: "You know?"

dialogues.speaker: Nemu
dialogues.jp: 「ど、どうしたのお兄ちゃん？」
dialogues.en: "What is it?"
dialogues.text: "What is it?"

dialogues.jp: 立ち上がって、腕を回しながら首をかしげる。
dialogues.en: "I'll go fix you something to eat."
dialogues.text: "I'll go fix you something to eat."

dialogues.jp: 「なんだろな……？」
dialogues.en: I stood up and folded my arms as I tilted my head.
dialogues.text: I stood up and folded my arms as I tilted my head.

dialogues.jp: 「なんかひっかかるんだよなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "What is it? Something's bothering me......"
dialogues.text: "What is it? Something's bothering me......"

dialogues.jp:
音夢の視線を背中に受けながら、全身をリラッ
クスさせる。
（なーんか、違うんだよな）
dialogues.en: I tried to relax my body as I felt her eyes on my back.
dialogues.text: I tried to relax my body as I felt her eyes on my back.

dialogues.jp:
和菓子にマヨネーズかけてるような、なにか根
本的な点での間違いを犯している気がした。
dialogues.en: (What a pain......)
dialogues.text: (What a pain......)

dialogues.jp:
答えは見つからないまま、とりあえず、台所に
立つ。
dialogues.en: It felt like something was wrong from the start.
dialogues.text: It felt like something was wrong from the start.

dialogues.jp: 「なに食べたいんだ音夢――あれ？」
dialogues.en: "What do you want to eat, Nemu? ...Huh?"
dialogues.text: "What do you want to eat, Nemu? ...Huh?"

dialogues.jp:
振り返った先、ソファーはいつのまにか、もぬ
けの殻になっていた。
dialogues.en: I turned around, but the sofa was empty.
dialogues.text: I turned around, but the sofa was empty.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.jp:
クッションを持ち上げるが、さすがにそこには
いない。
dialogues.en: I lifted the cushion, but she wasn't there.
dialogues.text: I lifted the cushion, but she wasn't there.

dialogues.jp: 「あれ？」
dialogues.en: "What?"
dialogues.text: "What?"

dialogues.jp:
一応、冷蔵庫と冷凍庫を開けてもみたが、音夢
の姿はどこにもなかった。
dialogues.en:
I opened the refrigerator and the freezer, but I couldn't
find her.
dialogues.text:
I opened the refrigerator and the freezer, but I couldn't
find her.

dialogues.jp: 「トイレか？」
dialogues.en: "Is she in the bathroom?"
dialogues.text: "Is she in the bathroom?"

dialogues.jp:
居間を出て廊下を見渡し、トイレの戸をノック
する。
dialogues.en:
I walked out to the hallway and knocked on the bathroom
door.
dialogues.text:
I walked out to the hallway and knocked on the bathroom
door.

dialogues.jp: ……いない。
dialogues.en: ......No answer.
dialogues.text: ......No answer.

dialogues.jp: と、なんとなく２階から人の気配がする。
dialogues.en: Then, I felt something from upstairs.
dialogues.text: Then, I felt something from upstairs.

dialogues.jp: 部屋に着替えに戻ったのだろうか。
dialogues.en: Did she go back to her room to change?
dialogues.text: Did she go back to her room to change?

dialogues.jp: 「せわしないというか……」
dialogues.en: "That was fast......"
dialogues.text: "That was fast......"

dialogues.jp:
いや、鈴の音もしなかったから、むしろ素晴ら
しい抜き足といってもよい。
dialogues.en:
I didn't even hear her bell, so it must have been a really
quiet, fast tiptoe.
dialogues.text:
I didn't even hear her bell, so it must have been a really
quiet, fast tiptoe.

dialogues.jp: 階段を上って音夢の部屋に向かう。
dialogues.en: I went upstairs to her room.
dialogues.text: I went upstairs to her room.

dialogues.jp: 「音夢？」
dialogues.en: "Nemu?"
dialogues.text: "Nemu?"

dialogues.jp: 呼びかけに、小さな寝息が答えた。
dialogues.en: I heard quiet breathing instead of an answer.
dialogues.text: I heard quiet breathing instead of an answer.

dialogues.jp: 「おい、飯は……」
dialogues.en: "Hey, what about breakfast......"
dialogues.text: "Hey, what about breakfast......"

dialogues.jp: 伸ばしかけた手を、そのまま頭の後ろに当てる。
dialogues.en: I put my hand on the back of my head as I called out to her.
dialogues.text: I put my hand on the back of my head as I called out to her.

dialogues.jp: 「まぁ、いいけど」
dialogues.en: "Never mind."
dialogues.text: "Never mind."

dialogues.jp: ため息混じりに呟いて、そのまま部屋を出た。
dialogues.en: I sighed and left her room.
dialogues.text: I sighed and left her room.

dialogues.jp: その日、音夢はそのまま眠り続けたままで。
dialogues.en: Nemu kept sleeping that day.
dialogues.text: Nemu kept sleeping that day.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、なんだかずっと居心地の悪さを感じなが
ら、まったりとその日を過ごした。
dialogues.en: I just sat in the house feeling uncomfortable after that.
dialogues.text: I just sat in the house feeling uncomfortable after that.

dialogues.jp: ◆現実の世界にて眠る◆
dialogues.en: ◆Sleeping in the real world◆
dialogues.text: ◆Sleeping in the real world◆

dialogues.jp:
なにかが違う。いつもと違う音夢の様子に違和
感を憶えた俺。
dialogues.en:
It felt different. Nemu seemed different to me, it felt
weird.
dialogues.text:
It felt different. Nemu seemed different to me, it felt
weird.

dialogues.jp:
視線を逸らすと、なぜか目の前から音夢が消え
ていて、ベッドに横たわっていた。
dialogues.en:
I looked away from her and she disappeared suddenly. Then, I
found her in her room sleeping on the bed.
dialogues.text:
I looked away from her and she disappeared suddenly. Then, I
found her in her room sleeping on the bed.

dialogues.jp:
そして、その日は、ずっと居心地の悪さを覚え
ることになった。
dialogues.en: I felt uncomfortable all day after that.
dialogues.text: I felt uncomfortable all day after that.
